OrderLineItem.description: Send all orders to be updated in a jsonl file, where each json item is in its own row. Must include all orders for a given date for a product. Meaning, if you send one order for a product for 2025-01-17, you must send all orders for that product for that date.

soldFrom.description: ID of the shop, channel, website, POS. Should match storeId in the Store object

orderLineNumber.description: Order line number of the product line item

createdAt.description: date-time of the creation date for the order in UTC

price.description: Price what the customer paid for the item (all discounts, taxes and other charges included)

currency.description: Three letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

quantity.description: How many items were sold of this particular sku

productId.description: Unique global identifier for the product, needs to match the gid in the ProductVariant object. Grouping factor for sales analytics

sku.description: Stock keeping unit of the product. This must match the sku in the ProductVariant object

bundleId.description: If the item is a part of a bundle, this field is used to group the bundles with matching id

taxAmount.description: Amount of tax applied to the line item

discountAmount.description: Amount of discount applied to the line item

originalPrice.description: Original (RRP) price of the line item, including tax and excluding discount

additionalProperties.description: additional properties related to this order

ProductVariant.description: Send all variants to be updated in a jsonl file, where each json item is in its own row

gid.description: Unique global identifier for the variant, to distinguish it from the other variants. Use sku if no other id is available

groupId.description: A grouping id with which the variant is tied to other variants. Used for grouping in analytics and pricing and user interface. Usually a parentProduct's id, if no other groups exist. If no grouping id exists, use gid

groupName.description: Name of the group this variant belongs to. Will be used in the user interface to group the variants under the parent and display this value as the group name

price.description: Price what the customer pays (with VAT)

compareAtPrice.description: Compare at Price / Suggested retail price, expressed as a decimal number of major currency units. Required if onSale is true

categories.description: Names of the categories the item is belongs to. Send them in order from highest to lowest. Used as a grouping factor amongst different items. If no category exists send ['All']

currency.description: Three letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

sku.description: SKU (stock keeping unit) of the product. This must match the sku in the orders

cogs.description: All costs related to the product, used to calculate margins. If cogsNotAvailable is true, send 0.01

cogsCurrency.description: Provide cogs currency, if the cogs is in another currency other than the default. Three letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

stockCount.description: Amount of items available in stock. If stockCountNotAvailable is true, send 10000000

cogsNotAvailable.description: If the cogs are not available, send true. Otherwise it's considered false

parentProductId.description: Parent product id, if the variant is a child of a parent product.

variantStatus.description: Status of the product, is it active or disabled. Considered enabled by default

stockCountNotAvailable.description: If the stock count is not available, send true. Otherwise it's considered false

ean.description: European Article Number. Unified code for products. Required for competitor matching

imageUrl.description: Url to the image of the product

productType.description: What kind of a product is it

onSale.description: if the product is on sale send true. Otherwise it's considered false

dateForPrice.description: ISO Date for the price, if in the past

tags.description: Possible tags to help with grouping, searching and sorting

marginTargetPercentile.description: Target margin percentile for the product

recommendedRetailPrice.description: Recommended retail price for the product

vatRate.description: Default vat rate in percentile. If multiple vat rates are used, use the supplemental data upload to send the vat rates for each variant per store

inventoryPolicy.description: Inventory policy for the product, can it continue selling even if the stock runs out. If no value is sent, the default is CONTINUE

otherPrices.description: Any and all other currencies and prices that the product may be sold at

additionalProperties.description: additional properties related to this product

CompetitorProductVariant.description:
Competitor variant is automatically matched to product variants by their sku. 
That's why sku is mandatory, along with price and currency and the date when the price was collected. 
Send all competitor variants to be updated in a jsonl file, where each json item is in its own row

gid.description: Unique global identifier for the variant, to distinguish it from the other variants. Use sku if no other id is available

price.description: Price what the customer pays (with VAT)

currency.description: Three letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

sku.description: This must match the SKU of the product in the ProductVariant object to create a match

storeId.description: If the competitor product is supposed to be matched to a specific store, send the storeId here. Otherwise leave it empty. Must match the storeId in the Store object

compareAtPrice.description: Compare at Price / Suggested retail price, expressed as a decimal number of major currency units. Required if onSale is true

storeId.description: Identifier for the store, must match the store identifier in the Store object

imageUrl.description: Url to the image of the product

recommendedRetailPrice.description: Recommended retail price for the product

vatRate.description: Default vat rate in percentile. If multiple vat rates are used, use the supplemental data upload to send the vat rates for each variant per store

currency.description: Three letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

originalPrice.description: Compare at Price / Suggested retail price, expressed as a decimal number of major currency units

Store.description: Send all store data to be updated in a jsonl file, where each json item is in its own row

storeId.description: id of the store, can be the same as name, but must be unique and match the storeId in the StoreProduct object, and the soldFrom in the OrderLineItem object

pricingEnabled.description: Is pricing enabled for the store

region.description: Region where the store is located

zone.description: Zone within the region where the store is located

additionalAttributes.description: Additional attributes related to the store

SupplementalData.description: Send all supplemental data to be updated for products in a jsonl file, where each json item is in its own row

gid.description: Unique global identifier that matches the product variant to which the data is to be added to

additionalProperties.description: Any number of different attributes and values related to the supplemental data
